source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check ME firmware status value is normal.
1. Check the information of test item

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Information should be correct and still be correct after rebooting

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ls /sys/class/mei/ 2>&1; echo ---; intelmetool -s 2>&1 || echo "ME Firmware Status Value tool not installed"; echo ---; dmesg | grep -iE "me.fw|status" | tail -20
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: read the ME firmware status value (ME Firmware Status Value) via the MEI/SPS channel. The agent collects whatever MEI/SPS registers/dmesg lines are reachable; confirming the value is CORRECT requires knowing the expected value (a user-supplied baseline), so this is PARTIAL: agent returns the raw readout, user judges it against the expected ME Firmware Status Value.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: read-only attempt against Intel MEI/SPS registers using vendor tools (intelmetool / mei-amt-check) that may not be installed on the SUT; install/availability must be confirmed first, and the expected baseline value must be provided by the user.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes the expected status value is external, but neither proves intelmetool -s read-only/platform semantics nor performs the required post-reboot comparison.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; requires platform-correlated normal value, safe query, one approved reboot and raw pre/post values.
historical_reviews.round_02: PARTIAL; returns raw data for owner judgment but conflates verdict ownership with automation capability.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: Confirms the expected value and verified read-only query are necessary evidence boundaries.

original_test_intent: Read the exact Intel ME firmware status value/register set for the identified platform, compare it with the owner-defined normal value and verify it remains correct after an approved reboot.
original_method: Using a documented platform-valid read-only query, capture the raw ME status value and decoded meaning before reboot, perform one controlled approved reboot, repeat the identical query and compare both results with the authoritative normal-value definition.
manual_activity: An authorized user supplies the normal status-value definition, confirms the query is read-only, approves the reboot plan and issues the verdict. The status queries, reboot, reconnect, comparison and evidence capture require no inherent physical or visual action and can be automated.
required_inputs: Exact platform/SKU, ME/SPS generation and firmware identity
Authoritative expected raw status value(s), bit-field decode and normality rule
Approved read-only ME status utility/version/exact syntax and target-selection behavior
Maintenance approval, workload check, reconnect timeout and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Do not run a query mode with ME write, provisioning, reset, flash or state-change capability.
Do not use broad dmesg text as the status value or compare an uncorrelated ME instance.
Preserve prior logs and obtain approval before rebooting the host.
Stop on target ambiguity, unsupported status layout, tool error, pre/post mismatch or recovery anomaly; never auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the normal value/bit decode and read-only tool, inventory exact platform/ME identity and capture raw pre-reboot status.
Perform one approved controlled reboot and track availability/reconnect through the defined recovery boundary.
Repeat the same query, compare raw and decoded pre/post/expected status, and collect platform health without setting PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Provide the platform-specific normal ME status value and bit definitions and approve the query tool.
Approve reboot, maintenance and recovery parameters.
Review the comparison and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: sysfs and dmesg are ancillary only. intelmetool -s may have platform-dependent output/semantics and its read-only contract is not established; the sequence also lacks reboot and a second status-value read.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the exact owner/vendor-approved read-only status-register query for the identified ME generation, retaining raw and decoded values before and after the approved reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: ME Firmware Status Value normality, post-reboot persistence and 5/0-minute fields are preserved; no normal register value is guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture structured raw ME status register/value output with field decode, tool/platform identity and identical pre/post reboot invocations; compare against the supplied generation-specific normal mask/value.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the exact ME/SPS generation for which the status layout and tool are documented.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record ME/SPS firmware, BIOS, MEI driver, query utility, OS and kernel.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Use the platform/vendor ME firmware status-register documentation and approved diagnostic guide supplied for execution.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw-value identity, bit decode and the omitted reboot/re-query evidence chain.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; both normal value and persistence are required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Generation-specific status layout, expected mask/value and validated query.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A zero or generic 'normal' string is not universally valid; reserved and sticky bits can differ by generation and boot phase.

project_override_considerations: A project defines the expected status mask/value, interpretation and reboot plan. Supplying these and later judging the evidence does not reduce full automation capability; results must remain bound to the stated ME generation.
expected_evidence: Platform/SKU, ME/SPS/BIOS/MEI identities and read-only query-tool manifest
Authoritative raw expected status value/mask and bit-field decode
Raw and decoded pre-reboot status, approved reboot/downtime/reconnect transcript and raw/decoded post-reboot status
Expected/pre/post comparison, BMC/SEL/kernel health, Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The request for a normal ME status value and the criterion's post-reboot correctness are consistent. The unspecified normal value and query details are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The status-value and persistence objective are clear. Missing masks/tools/reboot parameters delay readiness but are not a permanent semantic blocker, and every core action is electronically automatable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its warning about missing baselines and platform tools but rejects PARTIAL and the unverified generic query.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its safe-query, platform-correlation and reboot controls but advances capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE because approval and verdict are separate dimensions.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Distinguishes raw register value, decoded state, Tool Result and engineer verdict and adds the missing persistence sequence.

review_improvement: Prevents arbitrary 'normal' interpretations and correctly classifies a fully electronic pre/post reboot comparison without treating absent project data or engineer verdict as partial execution.
independent_technical_reasoning: The case requires no physical setup: once the expected generation-specific status value and safe query are supplied, read, reboot, reconnect and re-read are automatable. Therefore FULLY AUTOMATABLE is correct while execution readiness remains pending.
